sections.overview: HDFC Mid Cap Fund is an open-ended Mid Cap scheme managed by HDFC. The benchmark index is NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index (NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI).
sections.investment_objective: The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation/income by investing predominantly in Mid-Cap companies.
sections.fund_house: HDFC Mutual Fund is managed by HDFC Asset Management Company (AMC) Limited, one of India's largest and most trusted mutual fund houses.
sections.benchmark: The benchmark index for HDFC Mid Cap Fund is NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index (NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI).
sections.riskometer: The riskometer classification for HDFC Mid Cap Fund is Very High. It carries a Very High risk profile as per regulatory risk-o-meter guidelines.
sections.expense_ratio: The expense ratio for HDFC Mid Cap Fund (Direct Plan) is 0.76%.
